chunks: Witnessed by those who are honoured.

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبُونَ: The Muqarrabun (those brought near to God)

ai.seo_question: Who are the Muqarrabun who witness the events described in Surah Al-Mutaffifin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Muqarrabun' are distinguished not only as angels but also as the most righteous humans, such as the Imams, who possess a unique spiritual proximity to the Divine. This verse underscores their role as witnesses to the cosmic justice unfolding in the Hereafter, validating the ultimate triumph of the faithful over the deceitful. The term highlights the hierarchical nature of spiritual ascent, where closeness to God grants a privileged vantage point on divine decrees.
